image_description: A close-up view of a suit of historical armor, specifically focusing on the torso. The central element is a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) with a raised center ridge and anatomical contouring. It is accompanied by pauldrons (shoulder armor), faulds (waist armor), and tassets (thigh guards). The metal plates are worn over a blue chainmail hauberk or gambeson. The armor shows signs of wear, including rust spots and leather straps.
